title: A custom steel stamp order
passage: Here's how we price custom steel stamps. We charge for making the first one from your drawing. Extras from that drawing cost less, even later; give us the original drawing number when reordering. A changed drawing needs a new quote. To see how the mark looks on your material, send an offcut big enough for three impressions. We keep it on file for six months rather than putting it in your shipment.
passageZh: 以下是客製鋼印的計價方式。第一個依圖製作的鋼印會收費。同一張圖加做鋼印會較便宜，日後再訂也一樣；加訂時請提供原圖號。圖面若有變更，需要重新報價。如要確認印痕在你的材料上呈現的效果，請寄來足夠試印三次的邊料。這塊邊料會存檔六個月，不會隨貨寄回。
